'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Steve Harpster LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Naboo Future duel package. Inventory header Steven Hamster.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See / Careful For What You Wish For (V)|It Is The Future You See (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
